# Flame v2.7.0

## Quote sources
- Keep the existing local quote library as the default and add an independent JSON endpoint source.
- Configure an endpoint URL, optional Bearer or query-string authentication, and JSONPath expressions for quote text and author.
- Test endpoint settings before saving and preview the formatted quote. Append the author in parentheses when available.
- Preserve the local library when switching sources and use it as a fallback if the endpoint fails.
- Keep the configured authentication credential out of public configuration responses.

## Clock customization
- Set colors independently for hours, minutes, seconds and both separators.
- Choose theme primary, secondary or tertiary colors, their dimmed variants, or fixed HEX values.
- Theme-linked colors update automatically. All five elements default to primary.

## Settings and quality
- Separate Interface, Clock and Quotes settings pages.
- Update documentation and extend API integration and Chromium browser tests.

Docker images are published for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
